title: Multipoint Seshadri Constants and Nagata-Type Conjectures
exact_target: For sufficiently many sufficiently general points $Z$ on a polarized variety $(X,L)$, is the Seshadri constant $\varepsilon(X,L;Z)$ maximal possible? In $\mathbb{P}^{2}$ this includes Nagata's conjecture for $r\geq10$ general points and the SHGH prediction for plane linear systems.
